title: TAI Scan Tool: A RAG-Based Tool With Minimalistic Input for Trustworthy AI Self-Assessment
reasoning: The paper presents a tool for Trustworthy AI (TAI) self-assessment. TAI is defined as a framework consisting of ethical, legal, and robust components, aimed at safeguarding human values and respecting ethical principles. While the current tool iteration emphasizes legal compliance with the AI Act, it is built within the broader context of evaluating AI against ethical and trustworthy standards.
